sample_unit: CCTA examinations (development); external tests 442, 120, and 150 examinations
models_evaluated: Deep learning coronary stenosis detection model for heavily calcified plaques on CCTA

links.outcome: Radiologist diagnostic performance with versus without DL assistance in reader study
links.effect: DL assistance improved radiologist specificity by 7%-11% (P < .001) with improving AUC and increased interreader agreement (Δκ = 0.155-0.228; P < .05).
links.quote: In external testing dataset 2, DL assistance improved radiologist specificity by 7%-11% (P < .001) with improving AUC and increased interreader agreement (Δκ = 0.155-0.228; P < .05).

links.outcome: Model AUC versus clinical reports on prospectively collected CCTA examinations
links.effect: Model demonstrated 53% specificity and a higher AUC versus clinical reports (0.91 vs 0.76; P < .001).
links.quote: In external testing dataset 3, the model demonstrated 53% specificity and a higher AUC versus clinical reports (0.91 vs 0.76; P < .001).

screen.reason: The study includes a multi-reader study directly evaluating the impact of AI assistance on radiologists' diagnostic accuracy and interreader agreement compared to unassisted reading.
